train_multi_hop_dense_retrieval: train a multi-hop dense retrieval model from a pretrained RoBERTa encoder using CLI arguments
predict_multi_hop_retrieval: run inference on a trained multi-hop dense retrieval model and evaluate MRR scores
run_mhop_training_loop: run the training loop with gradient accumulation, FP16 support, and periodic evaluation on dev data
evaluate_mhop_model: evaluate a multi-hop retriever model on a dataset and compute MRR-1, MRR-2, and average MRR
configure_mhop_training_args: configure training hyperparameters including learning rate, batch size, warmup ratio, and sequence lengths
